item.text: {"summary":"The failures all involve numeric UTC offset parsing: valid signed offsets produce timestamps shifted in the wrong direction, and `-1` is accepted for both `%z` and `%Ez`. `ParseTime` delegates parsing to CCTZ, but the supplied source does not include the offset parser, so the repair location and parsing/error contract are not yet established.","hypotheses":["The CCTZ numeric-offset parser applies the sign with the wrong polarity, shifting timestamps by twice the stated offset.","The CCTZ offset parser accepts incomplete numeric forms such as `-1` instead of rejecting them with a parse error.
